dialogues.en:
<$comeff(3,5)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,6)>Yooo! <$cdef(27)> and friends! You all got
a sec?

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>My, <$cdef(27)>, you do seem to find the
most
unusual
Pokémon...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>You’re called <$cdef(27)>Rotom—is that right, pumpkin? Goodness,
you do seem to have a lot of energy!

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>I heard you all wanna make a totally poppin’ town here!
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,9)>And I have a real good idea for how to make the vibes
IMMACULATE.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, you’re going to help us out too? What a sweetie you
are! Thank you!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Indeed! We would be very grateful. Would you please
share your idea with us?

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>There’s only one way to make it happen, yo—we gotta have
a PARTYYY!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>A...party? What exactly are you thinking of?

<$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, a party sounds lovely! This brings back so many fond
memories...

<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,9)>Yeah! A PARTY! With hype music! And singing! And
dancing! And eatin’ good food, yo!

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Ahh, right, yes, a PARTY! Yes, of course—that is more
or less what I was picturing.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, indeed... That does sound quite fun!

<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,8)>I knew you’d be down, <$cdef(27)>! Let’s
get
working
on
the preparations!

<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,8)>I knew you’d be down, <$cdef(27)>! Let’s
get
working
on
the preparations!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>And what would those be? Could you tell us what we
ought to do?
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,6)>We can figure that out as we go, yo! Let’s get to it!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, I am SO looking forward to having a party! After all,
the most important thing you need for a party is FOOD!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I’ll show you all my very best cooking and whip up a
special spread just for the party!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Yes, please do look forward to it! That being said...
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I wonder what I should cook.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>A special dish for a special party... <$voicel(2,3)>I need to think hard
about this.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>...Now that you mention it, I hadn’t thought that far.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I wonder, what SHOULD I cook?
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>A special dish for a special party...<$voicel(2,3)>I need to think hard
about this.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>I definitely want to include <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> in whatever
we make... And of course <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> are a must...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>But the big question is, what dish will incorporate ALL
of that?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>Aaah, my mind’s a scrambled mess right now—I just can’t
seem to get my thoughts in order!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>You know what—maybe it would be better if we set up the
party venue before worrying about all that!
<$comeff(2,5)><$voicel(2,6)>So you’re going to need this, <$cdef(27)>!
You got a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1729)></color> from <$cdef(27)><$cname;1(216)></color>!

<$voicel(2,8)>This place looks good for a party. It’s got a lot of space!
<$voicel(2,6)>Would you be a dear and clear away some of that ash and
stone that’s in the way?
<$voicel(2,7)>Then you can set up that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> somewhere
around here.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>If you set up a wonderful party venue...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I’m sure it’d inspire me to come up with a wonderful
dish too!

<$voicel(2,5)>Would you be a dear and set up the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)>
somewhere around here?
<$voicel(2,8)>After you’ve made a bit more space, of course, by getting
rid of the rocks and ash and stuff!

<$voicel(2,10)>Be sure to come talk to me again after you’ve placed that
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)>!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>This place is starting to look ready for a party! And it’s all
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,8)>Yooo! So this is the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> you all’ve been
talkin’ about, huh?! I’m diggin’ the culinary vibe!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>All right, this is sure to inspire some great ideas for the
party dish! Any minute now!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>It’s no use! I can’t come up with a single thing!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m so sorry, <$cdef(27)>. And after you
went
through
all
that
trouble
to
set
the
place up!

<$facial(2,1)><$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,8)><$cdef(27)>Chef! Yooo, that gives me an awesome idea! <$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,10)>If you can’t
come UP with a good recipe, then maybe we just need to
get DOWN!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>And...what does that mean exactly?

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,6)>Get dowwwn! Get groovin’, y’know? What if we get
everyone in the <$cdef(27)>mood for a party first <$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,8)>while <$cdef(27)>Chef’s thinkin’?!
<$comeff(3,5)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,9)>If everyone’s in the right <$cdef(27)>mood, comin’ up with an
awesome party food idea should be EASY!
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,7)>I believe in you, <$cdef(27)>Chef! I know you’ve got this!
<$facial(3,1)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Haven’t you two only just met?

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Well...despite that, I’m beginning to agree! It DOES feel
like I could come up with a good idea if the mood is right!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>How about it then, <$cdef(27)>, sweetie?
Would
you
be
a
little
<$cdef(27)>mood maker
for us?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>I know I’ve done nothing but ask favors of you but... Well,
I’m asking again!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>How about it then, <$cdef(27)>, sweetie?
Would
you
be
a
little
<$cdef(27)>mood maker
for us?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>I know I’ve done nothing but ask favors of you but... Well,
I’m asking again!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Hoho! That really does sound quite festive!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>But...how exactly are we meant to raise the <$cdef(27)>mood?

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,6)>We can figure that out as we go, yo! Looks like the <$cdef(27)>mood’s
<$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>sittin’ around <$cdef(27)> right now. <$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,9)>We gotta get hype
and crank it up to <$cdef(27)>100!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>I’ll stay here and keep thinking about what would make
the perfect party dish!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Meanwhile, would you please work on raising the <$cdef(27)>mood
around here, dear?

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, and I’ve decided on the ingredients for the dish,
at least!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,668)><$voicel(2,9)>Please don’t forget to put those ingredients into the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)>!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Let’s work on getting everyone around here all gung ho for
the party until the <$cdef(27)>mood reaches <$cdef(27)>100!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>If you want to know how the <$cdef(27)>mood is doing at the moment,
you can ask <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(274)>.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, you’ve set up the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)>? How kind!
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>It...IS a bit far away though...
<$voicel(2,8)>I think right around here would be better!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>A party, eh? I don’t have much experience with those, but
the idea is quite exciting!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)><$cdef(27)>Chef Dente seems more knowledgeable than I
about parties.

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,8)>Yooo! Music is, like, the SOUL of the party, right? But an
epic party should have some epic food too!

<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>If you know any Pokémon who’re legit in the kitchen,
you should totally talk with ’em about this, yo!
